findings: TEXT_CONTAMINATION: S01, S02 and S04 contain large Korean speech/thought bubbles; V2 master art must be text-free.
PHONE_GEOMETRY_FAIL: S02 shows the readable/front screen surface to the viewer instead of only back edge/oblique non-readable glow.
ANATOMY_CONTACT_FAIL: S02 adds a third expressive/self-touch hand at the mouth/chin while the other two hands already own jeans and phone.
STYLE_FAIL: faces/eyes, polished anime/webtoon finish, blush/heart embellishment and detail treatment drift materially from the PRIMARY_STYLE drawing grammar.
CAST_APPEARANCE_DRIFT: GF is a brown bob with shoulder bag rather than the locked low-bun episode-local appearance.
BACKGROUND_MINIMALISM: generally improved, but text bubbles and decorative emotion marks dominate the empty-space budget.
SEMANTIC_SEQUENCE: denim story sequence is broadly recognizable and S03 hand-wash beat is present.
FACIAL_ACTING: S01 and S04 are not exact duplicates, but acting cannot be accepted because the board fails objective gates above.
binary_persistence_note: The current execution surface exposes the generated PNG in the session runtime but not a direct binary-to-GitHub bridge. The rejected pixels are hash/handle evidenced here; no PASS depends on missing repository bytes.
